why_retroactive: the generating script was never written to disk; _lead4/ held 8 PNG + 3 JSON + 1 MD and no script. The definition was recovered verbatim from the producing session transcript, so this archive is itself a retroactive migration.

definition.background: exact modal 24-bit RGB per image (np.argmax over unique-value counts, no quantization)
definition.rowCorr: Pearson r of per-row ink counts
definition.colCorr: Pearson r of per-column ink counts
definition.flatBgPct: 100 * max(modal pixel count over the two images) / (H*W)
definition.verdict_rule: STRUCT-RELATED if inkOv>=50 and max(|rowCorr|,|colCorr|)>=0.5; UNRELATED/FAKE if inkOv<50 and max<0.5; else BORDERLINE

cross_validation.note: the two differing rows (headhunt, operator) are the two scenes whose similarity itself differs between the two commits, i.e. different input renders, not a definition difference.

measurement_point.note: measured at ec440bf; the commit this archive lands on is a later HEAD (5aa2ac3). git diff --stat ec440bf..5aa2ac3 -- src/ggrender/scene_card.go src/ggrender/render.go is empty, so the card render is unchanged and the numbers still hold -- but that is a separate verified claim, not that this file measured HEAD.

reading_notes.depot_inkOv_0.0: NOT A MEASUREMENT, NOT A VERDICT. depot flatBgPct=100.0 means the canvas is a single flat color, so the ink mask is the empty set by construction; an empty mask intersects nothing and its union equals the other mask, so inkOv is necessarily 0.0. The metric has no resolving power on a flat-color canvas. UNTESTABLE != UNQUALIFIED -- this row must not be read as depot faking or depot being structurally unrelated.
reading_notes.lottery_most_dangerous_row: sim 0.98358 is the closest non-passing row to the 0.99 gate, while inkOv=8.2 (second lowest of 16) and max(|rowCorr|,|colCorr|)=0.048 (lowest of 16) -> UNRELATED/FAKE. Highest score proximity, lowest structural relatedness. This row is what must stop the next person from trying to push lottery over the 0.99 gate: the score is carried by flat dark background, and raising similarity further would move a structurally unrelated page over the line without moving it toward the baseline.
reading_notes.cross_validation_boundary: 14 of 16 rows are identical to the last digit across all 5 metric fields. The 2 that differ (headhunt, operator) differ because the INPUT RENDERS differ between the two commits (their similarity differs too: 0.96476->0.79983 and 0.84554->0.69063), NOT because the definitions differ. There are not two definitions in conflict; there are two commits that rendered different images. Definition-level agreement is established independently by the calendar row (86.7 / +0.373 / +1.000 / 87.0) and the state row (71.8 / +0.950 / +0.978 / 70.7).
